items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The music of Monk and Charlie Parker, Dizzy, and so forth. ... Or the bebop stuff like Monk, Bud Powell, Tadd Dameron, you know.

ctx.x: Put on by the student council. But the music was so challenging and interesting then, that was when bebop was coming up, and the kids found it so interesting. The music of Monk and Charlie Parker, Dizzy, and so forth. They pulled their chairs up to the stage and sat down, and made a concert out of it. All these young people came in that later became famous, like Ira Sullivan who’s still with us, Richard Davis, Andrew Hill...
